checkpoints.description: Task 'keystone-commit-audit-v2' completed successfully.
[1/2] Plan: rebase the isolated prefab edit scene after a successful save so saved fields stop reporting as overrides

impact_assessment.why: Removing baseline seeding from apply_prefab_instance fixed rollback and nested-group behavior, but save_prefab_edit no longer rebased the edit scene; saved names and transforms appeared as overrides until close.
impact_assessment.benefits: Prefab edit mode reflects the saved template immediately, while failed writes leave the old baseline intact.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: prefab_edit override report only; dependency: existing baseline helper; concurrency: session lock unchanged; state: edit scene baseline and library write order.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Seed only after the library write succeeds, add a failing-first assertion to the existing round-trip test, and rerun the 6/6 gate.

[1/3] Plan: start the next cumulative cycle at range 1->3 and audit asset import, hot reload and glTF import for a new finding

impact_assessment.why: The cumulative cycle restarted at its beginning. Range 1->3 contains asset hot reload and glTF import, and a failed re-import currently replaces existing derived records without restoring them.
impact_assessment.benefits: Failed glTF re-imports become registry-atomic, so old prefabs cannot resolve to half-imported payloads.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: import_gltf failure path only; dependency: existing AssetRegistry records; concurrency: session lock unchanged; state: manifest, prefab file and replaced records.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Make the rollback failing-first, snapshot records before import, restore old payloads after removing new ids, and run the full 6/6 gate before pushing.

checkpoints.description: Task 'keystone-commit-audit-v3-1to3' completed successfully.
[1/3] Plan: audit range 1->6 for dirty-state, startup-scene and forget-asset gaps; fix stale asset payloads left in undo/redo snapshots after forget

impact_assessment.why: Range 1->6 introduced forget_asset. Usage checks cover live and saved content but not editor undo/redo snapshots, so forgetting an asset used by a deleted node lets Undo resurrect an unregistered payload.
impact_assessment.benefits: Forget becomes history-safe: undone nodes no longer point at removed mesh/material/texture payloads, and the report exposes how many snapshot references were cleared.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: forgotten_asset report grows; dependency: EditorHistory snapshot format; concurrency: session lock unchanged; state: undo/redo snapshots and registry removal order.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Clear only after the registry removal succeeds, handle mesh/material/texture identities, add a failing-first delete-forget-undo test, and run the 6/6 gate.

checkpoints.description: Task 'keystone-commit-audit-v3-1to6' completed successfully.
[1/3] Plan: audit range 1->9 build, asset-usage and texture-picker work; expose undo/redo asset references in asset_usages

impact_assessment.why: Range 1->9 added asset usage reporting, but it only scans live scene, registry, prefabs and scenes. Undo/redo snapshots can still hold a payload after the authored node is deleted, so AI and human clients cannot see that reference.
impact_assessment.benefits: Usage reports explain why history cleanup is needed and make stale-payload risk visible without changing forget's authored-content gate.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: additive asset_usages field; dependency: EditorHistory snapshot format; concurrency: session lock unchanged; state: undo/redo stacks.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Count mesh/material/texture identities in both stacks, keep the field out of references/found, add a delete-then-usage regression, and run the 6/6 gate.
